issues.description: Method addGuestStudents: the problem statement text (task description) specifies addGuestStudents(String) (i.e. a String parameter), while the UML in the same problem statement and the solution implementation specify addGuestStudents(int). The template file contains a TODO for the addGuestStudents method but the surrounding UML and final solution use an int parameter. This inconsistency leaves students uncertain whether to implement addGuestStudents accepting a String or an int; implementing the wrong signature will not match the UML/tests and may cause compilation or grading mismatches.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably update the problem statement task text to require addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and the solution, and clarify in the description that the method accepts an integer number of new guest students to add. If the intent was to accept a String, then update the UML, template TODO, and solution to use String and add guidance on parsing/validation.

issues.description: The concept is the method that adds guest students to a Lecture. In the problem statement prose (problem_statement.md) the method is documented as addGuestStudents(String) (lines 49-50). In the UML embedded in the same problem statement the method is declared as addGuestStudents(int): void (line 73). The template Lecture.java only contains a TODO for this method (no signature) (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 18). The solution implementation defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 90-92). This mismatch between addGuestStudents(String) in the prose and addGuestStudents(int) in the UML and solution will confuse students about the correct parameter type and signature to implement and test against.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. The simplest fix is to update the problem statement prose to specify addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and solution (change the text on problem_statement.md lines 49-50). Alternatively, if a String parameter was intended, change the UML, template, and solution to use addGuestStudents(String) and document how the String is parsed; prefer aligning to addGuestStudents(int) to minimize changes.
